main_text.p: raculis sic scribit prædictus Mantuanus: Magna quidem memorant alij miracula abipso Edita Syluestro: sed nullus idoneus autor, Nec tejis[?] productus adhuc: ideoq; relinquam Talia, quæ possunt quædam figmenta uideri. Nostra etenim nugas deliramentaq; damnat Religio, nec dat linguis mendacibus aures.

Baptista Mantuanus, in secundo libro de uita diui Blasij, adducit angelum ad eundem Blasium inter alia sic loquetem, de prædicti Cæsaris Constantini magni imperio, deq; fu uro ecclesiæ statu pacis tempore, de Cleri & populi uitijs, ac tandē plagis.
main_text.head: De Constantini imperio.
main_text.p: Nunc bonus, expulsis Romana in regna tyrannis, Adueniet Princeps, sub quo pacabitur orbis: Et sinem accipi ueterum cultura deorum.

Constantinus apud Thraces, qua Bosphorus æquor Thracius Euxinis Ægeum ingurgitat undis, Constituet sedem imperij: Latiumq; relinquet Christo, et Romuleam septem cum collibus urbem. Tunc insigne crucis, quondam damnabile, surget Ex humili in sublime loco: præcedet honore Romanos sasces, & regia signa, coronas. Tunc inter superos unà lætabimur ambo: Utq;[?] ab excelsa mundi speculabimur arce.

page.notes: The first word is a fragment at the page start: the first letters are cut off, the glyph is unclear. "tejis" in "Nec tejis" is doubtful. The date "324" is hard to read in the scan. "fu uro" is printed with a space. "Utq;" at the end is doubtful. The brace in the right margin is a grouping mark only, not text. Possible printing errors remain as printed.
